title: Black Light FTL Environmental Safety, Lookahead, Abort, and Recovery Certification Registry

authority.scope: Machine-readable safety certification layer for gravity/environment penalties, lookahead sufficiency, family-specific hazard observability, abortability, recovery reserve, and route admission. It operationalizes existing propulsion/transit mathematics without inventing new family canon or race ownership.
sourceOrder: named race / vessel / manufacturer / installation source
Google Drive: The different lightspeed methods

designSource.title: The different lightspeed methods
confirmedDesignRequirements: transit families have different gravity and miscalculation efficiency losses
large gravity wells impose rapidly rising burden and can prohibit emergence/commit
gravitational-plane travel is especially sensitive to shear geometry and forks
each family requires its own safety sensor package and emergency de-transit semantics
higher technology increases prediction horizon, redundancy, and intervention margin rather than granting perfect safety
mathematics should be internally coherent while invented coefficients remain clearly non-canon

environmentTerms.gravitySeverity: G = wPhi*|Phi/Phi_ref| + wg*|grad(Phi)|/g_ref + wT*||T||/T_ref + wR*||R||/R_ref + wU*U_mass. Coefficients remain DERIVED/PROPOSED calibration quantities.
environmentTerms.familyPenalty: P_f = a_f G + b_f G^2 + c_f G^(n_f) + d_f U_mass + e_f B_f; eta_g,f = exp(-P_f). Exact coefficients are not setting canon unless a higher-authority source establishes them.
environmentTerms.miscalculationAmplification: A_f = ||J_f,E||; eta_calc,f = exp(-k_f A_f^2 tr(Sigma_E)). This preserves family-specific sensitivity to the same environmental uncertainty.
environmentTerms.admissibility: Omega_f = {x : eta_g,f >= eta_min,f AND U_f <= U_max,f AND recoveryMargin_f > 0 AND lookaheadMargin_f > 0}.
environmentTerms.negativeEvidence: An absent hazard marker is usable only when instrument capability, spatial/temporal coverage, resolution, dynamic range, survivability, and damage history support detectability.

lookaheadModel.interventionTime: t_int = t_sensor + t_solver + t_decision + t_command + t_actuate + t_exit + t_clear + t_margin
lookaheadModel.interventionDistance: D_int = v_projected * t_int where projected speed is meaningful; nonlocal/commit systems use an equivalent decision-horizon representation instead of pretending local hull speed exists.
lookaheadModel.admissionRule: M_H must be positive for the worst credible observable route hazard, except for family states whose commit semantics make post-commit intervention impossible; those families must certify the complete precommit envelope instead.
lookaheadModel.observabilityRule: Loss of required hazard observability causes authority reduction, abort, or route rejection unless an independently validated guard channel preserves the relevant hazard class.

metric-compression.abortSemantics: Continuous or staged unwind while envelope closure and protected-volume integrity remain controllable; loss of closure observability triggers conservative authority reduction.
metric-compression.recoveryRequirement: Protected unwind energy, thermal sink, field-collapse symmetry, and post-unwind inertial stabilization remain outside ordinary cruise expenditure.
metric-compression.characteristicFailure: Metric mismatch or asymmetric collapse loads the protected volume, grows source burden, and can make safe closure impossible near severe curvature.

gravitational-plane.abortSemantics: Decouple from the hazardous plane before incompatible branch coupling exceeds structural/field limits, then recouple only to a certified local solution.
gravitational-plane.recoveryRequirement: Independent gravimetric guard channel, plane-decoupling authority, inertial stabilization, and a valid recoupling solution.
gravitational-plane.characteristicFailure: A fork can couple different parts of the maintained transit state toward incompatible gravitational branches, producing catastrophic field and structural loading.

slipstream-shear.abortSemantics: Reduce coupling and detach from the boundary layer while a valid normal-space exit correspondence remains available.
slipstream-shear.recoveryRequirement: Protected detachment energy, boundary-state sensing, exit-map validation, and post-detachment stabilization.
slipstream-shear.characteristicFailure: Correspondence drift or unstable adhesion can move the exit solution faster than the control system can safely follow.

q-lattice.abortSemantics: Reject the translation before commit or select a previously certified alternate address graph; post-commit semantics remain family/operator specific.
q-lattice.recoveryRequirement: Independent reference ancestry, protected address solution, rejection authority, and destination authentication.
q-lattice.characteristicFailure: Address aliasing, epoch drift, or corrupted reference ancestry can make the mathematically nearest solution the wrong physical state.

n-manifold.abortSemantics: Collapse to a certified lower-dimensional embedding or re-embed through a validated return map before conditioning becomes singular.
n-manifold.recoveryRequirement: Protected return-map solution, axis reserve, dimensional stabilization, and ordinary-space re-registration.
n-manifold.characteristicFailure: A shortcut can remain mathematically short while its return projection becomes ill-conditioned or ceases to map safely into the destination volume.

fold-jump.abortSemantics: Precommit rejection only once fold closure becomes causally/nonlocally committed; no invented mid-fold steering is permitted.
fold-jump.recoveryRequirement: Protected closure authority, destination-clearance proof, endpoint reference integrity, and post-fold ringing sink.
fold-jump.characteristicFailure: A formally valid adjacency solution can still intersect occupied, distorted, or uncertain destination volume if endpoint covariance exceeds clearance.

wormhole-gate.abortSemantics: Throttle, stabilize, or close the aperture while throat and mouth synchronization remain inside the certified closure envelope.
wormhole-gate.recoveryRequirement: Independent mouth references, throat stabilization reserve, closure actuators, structural load path, and post-flow thermal/field sink.
wormhole-gate.characteristicFailure: External tides, asymmetric flow, or synchronization error can drive throat asymmetry and anchor loading beyond stable aperture limits.

phase-displacement.abortSemantics: Reject before state commit when coverage, target compatibility, reference identity, or continuity checks fail; post-commit recovery is reconciliation, not fictional steering through transit.
phase-displacement.recoveryRequirement: Protected continuity record, target authentication, reconciliation capacity, and post-arrival state audit.
phase-displacement.characteristicFailure: An incomplete or incompatible target-state solution can preserve an apparently valid transfer while violating coverage, occupancy, or continuity constraints.

inertial-torch.abortSemantics: Throttle, rotate, burn, or coast according to ordinary causal propulsion constraints; no exotic de-transit state exists.
inertial-torch.recoveryRequirement: Maneuver reserve, thermal margin, structure, navigation solution, and collision avoidance.
inertial-torch.characteristicFailure: Ordinary high-energy trajectory failure, not exotic field collapse.

pathSafetyLadder.redundancyClass: single certified chain with manual oversight
pathSafetyLadder.safetyMeaning: tiny known envelope; unknown terrain generally rejected

pathSafetyLadder.responseClass: shipboard emergency exit where operator permits
pathSafetyLadder.redundancyClass: independent guard channel and protected recovery reserve
diverse sensing physics and redundant control paths

pathSafetyLadder.responseClass: preemptive reroute, alternate address/topology, or protected shunt where physically allowed
pathSafetyLadder.redundancyClass: common-cause analysis and remote reference diversity
pathSafetyLadder.safetyMeaning: unknown terrain becomes quantifiable rather than automatically safe

pathSafetyLadder.responseClass: rapid autonomous re-solve plus layered recovery
pathSafetyLadder.redundancyClass: diverse independent channels with degraded-mode certification
pathSafetyLadder.safetyMeaning: large safety margins; never absolute safety

invariants: REJECTED cannot be promoted by presentation/UI code
UNRESOLVED inputs cannot be silently coerced to safe defaults
loss of a required hazard-observability channel invalidates the certificate unless a validated independent guard covers that hazard
protected recovery reserve cannot be consumed to improve nominal range or speed
common-mode sensors do not multiply as independent redundancy
post-commit correction may only exist where the family operator explicitly supports it
equivalent speed cannot substitute for physical response time in nonlocal families
named manufacturer/race safety limits override generic derived defaults within their scope

order: only then expose route as selectable
generatorRules.downgradePolicy: If a requested route is unsafe, the generator may reduce speed/range, select another route, or return REJECTED. It may not lower environmental severity, erase uncertainty, or grant an unsupported emergency capability to satisfy the request.
generatorRules.numericPolicy: Gameplay coefficients may be supplied only as labeled calibration profiles. They are not setting-wide canon and must retain profile identity/version.
generatorRules.raceSpecificPolicy: Race/manufacturer embodiments customize sensors, controls, maintenance, materials, cognition, and failure handling without changing operator physics unless a higher source explicitly establishes a distinct mechanism.

api.sideEffects: none; this resolver certifies supplied state and does not mutate canon, measurements, or event history

canonGuards: Do not infer a civilization's transit family from possession of a safety sensor class.
Do not infer exact coefficients from the Drive design document.
Do not convert a family-specific gravity penalty into one universal exclusion radius.
Do not treat high Path or T-tier as immunity to gravity, uncertainty, sensor loss, or operator failure.
Do not invent mid-commit steering for Fold, displacement, or any other operator whose established semantics do not permit it.
Do not treat redundant displays sharing one sensor/reference root as independent safety channels.
Do not consume protected recovery reserve to make a nominal route pass certification.
Do not classify unresolved measurements as zero.
Do not use equivalent speed as a physical local velocity where the family is nonlocal.
Do not canonize generated gameplay calibration values through repetition.
Preserve named race/manufacturer/vessel safety doctrine over generic derived defaults.
Every certificate must retain the authority snapshot and environment epoch that produced it.
